title: Gated Luxury | Broadway Views | Rooftop Fire Pit
description:
Discover the essence of Nashville living within this brand new, chic residence, ideally positioned for city exploration. Revel in breathtaking vistas of Nashville skyline and fire-pit. This centrally located property sleeps 12 boasting 4 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, a fully furnished kitchen, and contemporary conveniences. Ideal for families, friend groups and corporate retreats the house is conveniently located near Broadway, ensuring an unforgettable experience!
